decision_rationale: This is presented as a new LLM, not a review or wrapper, and it is trained for single-cell annotation. The record explicitly links gene-expression inputs to cell type labels through reasoning-based annotation tasks.
evidence_snippet: “lightweight, open-source large language model (LLM) tailored for single-cell type annotation”; “directly maps cell-level gene expression profiles to cell type labels”; “model is expected to generate a cell type label directly from the input cell sentence”
